source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.

observations.range: Both forms accept 10^-99 and 10^99. A:B=X:D with A=10^-99,B=10^99,D=1 reports Math ERROR, as does A=10^99,B=10^-99,D=1.
observations.format: 1/10^7 stays fractional; 1/10^8 becomes scientific. Decimal A=0.1,B=3,D=1 gives 1/30; the negative equivalent gives -1/30.
observations.beta47: All3 cancellation navigation holdouts recovered unchanged. RIGHT does not close the literal exponent parenthesis;an explicitclose separately produces0.1 and1/30. No numeric calibration.
